prompt:
Write 7 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim, in time order. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text:
Entry 1: Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant reports a knee injury and is not represented by an attorney, so I am handling direct contact with the claimant.

Entry 2: Reviewed the first recorded statement. The claimant described the lane change and the contact on the rear passenger side in the same way as the initial report, and the account is consistent so far.

Entry 3: Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the accident happened as described and place the claimant in the vehicle at the time. Photos submitted by the other driver show damage that is mostly in line with the described impact.

Entry 4: Reviewed the vehicle appraisal. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The driver is a household member of the policyholder and is covered under the policy.

Entry 5: Claimant reports a knee injury that is plausible for a collision of this type. No prior injury to the same area is known from the records I have reviewed so far.

Entry 6: Medical treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. I have requested the treatment notes and will confirm progress before setting a reserve.

Entry 7: Claimant repeated the same account in each conversation since the first report. Treatment records are pending, and the file will be updated once they are received.
